name: Time Will Tell
source:
In 2013, while working a case at the NYPD, Samuel Reid found a mysterious watch at a crime, which he stole for himself, believing it was connected to his father's 2000 murder.

Upon discovering the watch had time-travelling powers, he opened a private investigation firm alongside his good friend, defence attorney Zahra Modi. Now he uses the watch to travel back in time and solve cases. 

There's just one catch: He can't interfere, lest space and time collapse due to resulting butterfly effects.

[From [url=https://magvellian.itch.io/time-will-tell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2013年，纽约市警察局的Samuel Reid在调查案件时，于犯罪现场发现了一块神秘手表。他怀疑它与父亲在2000年遇害一事有关，便偷偷将其据为己有。

发现手表拥有穿越时间的能力后，他与好友、辩护律师Zahra Modi一起开办了私人侦探事务所。如今，他利用手表回到过去，侦破案件。

不过，有一条限制：他不能干涉过去，否则，由此引发的蝴蝶效应会令时空崩溃。

[摘自[url=https://magvellian.itch.io/time-will-tell]Itch.io[/url]]
